title: African Union appoints ex-Credit Suisse boss as envoy for virus support
description: Source: https://www.spreaker.com/user/africapodcastnetwork/african-union-appoints-ex-credit-suisse-  The African Union has appointed former Credit Suisse boss Tidjane Thiam and several other dignitaries as a special envoy to solicit international support to help the continent deal with the economic impact of the coronavirus. The envoy team, which was named by the AU chairman, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, also includes former Nigerian Finance Minister Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, former South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel, and Donald Kaberuka, former president and chairman of the African Development Bank. The AU said in a statement that the envoys will be tasked with soliciting rapid and concrete support pledged by the G20, the European Union and other financial institutions.  ---   Support this podcast: https://anchor.fm/newscast-africa/support
